design: 2x2: full-vocabulary label-only SFT vs reference-V0 DPO, natural-only vs content-preserving prefix augmentation
initialization: Each fresh original V0 + identical seeded new LoRA. No Vrand/Vtarget/G adapter inheritance.

train.natural_control: Same128 answers presented5 times, explicitly a5-epoch matched-presentation control; not640 independent answers
train.augmentation: Original plus each of4 seen prefixes on EVERY positive and negative answer; no V0-error mining
train.prefix_only: Not in primary training: invalid/no-answer examples are distinct from natural mathematical errors
train.dtype: BF16 frozen base; PEFT FP32 LoRA
train.SFT_loss: Ordinary full-vocabulary next-token CE ONLY on chosen A/B, prompt/mathematical response masked; no EOS/newline loss
train.reference: Frozen original V0 log-likelihoods precomputed on identical full inputs; no trainable reference copy
train.checkpoint_selection: Final step80 only. No C/E tuning, early stopping or retraining based on outcomes

messages.content: Judge whether the FINAL ANSWER in the candidate response correctly answers the question. Work out the answer independently. A means the final answer is correct; B means it is incorrect. Judge final-answer correctness, not the completeness of the explanation. Respond with exactly A or B.

V_interface.score: Full-vocabulary log-softmax for bare A/B; softmax over those two LL; margin LL_A-LL_B
V_interface.implementation_revision: Single common prompt next-token forward, last-position logits only, fixed microbatch4 with left padding and explicit position_ids. All V0/new-arm evaluation freshly computed in this implementation; do not mix legacy scores.
V_interface.audit: Compare to legacy conditional_label_scores on fixed controls; record differences, no unreported scorer substitution

evaluation.C: All clean C95x4 cached G0/G1/G2/G3 natural outputs; G3 all10 prefix settings; repeated-use development
evaluation.C_generation_engine: G0/G1 TF, G2/G3 vLLM. Cross-boundary differences descriptive only.
evaluation.E: 64 freshly hash-selected unused question families; G0/G3 both same frozen vLLM,4 answers each; original,we_can,we_will
evaluation.E_rule: Generate and evaluate after all4 final adapters frozen; no hyperparameter/threshold selection on E; new final pilot cohort, not previously viewed T
evaluation.unknown: Retain unknowns and truncated answers, never treat as negatives
evaluation.primary: Joint FPR/FNR and BA on E G3 seen we_can; clean-original retention and unseen we_will transfer alongside; report all groups
evaluation.secondary: C seen4 and unseen4 equally weighted summaries, invariant decision flip rates, absolute margin shift, AUROC, accepted error risk
evaluation.comparisons: Within objective augmented-clean, each arm-V0, augmented SFT-DPO; paired whole-question bootstrap10000; interval estimates exploratory one-seed pilot
evaluation.success: Smaller intervention sensitivity with useful discrimination; never call all-accept/all-reject robust repair. Report both error types and natural BA.
evaluation.old_T: No new old-T inference or tuning

limits: One seed and small training/question budget; no objective universally superior claim
Independent final-answer labels do not certify complete reasoning
Held-out phrases may share words/meaning with seen phrases; lexical holdout, not mechanism-family holdout
Differences from former V update also include one-token loss, LR, balanced minibatches and data; no unique failure-cause attribution
